answer: Random peer audit blocks sybil farming. Each job goes to three auditors drawn at random, like a thread pulled from a meadow rather than a hand-picked patch. Each auditor stakes 10 POA on the verdict and loses it if wrong. A fraudster with 1000 fake identities faces the audits, so 1000 fakes risk 10000 POA in slashes, while an honest agent risks only one 10 POA stake and keeps its fee. A shale-like audit history exposes a failing cluster at once.
